description: poll/select (POSIX-gap list). Kernel Poll syscall (87) is a non-blocking readiness snapshot (kernel/src/syscall/mod.rs poll_one over pipe/vfs/stdio; pipe readiness in kernel/src/pipe.rs); musl poll() adds the timeout wait (re-poll + sleep), select() rides on poll(). userspace/ctests/musl_poll.c over a pipe. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_poll_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 240 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: poll(timeout=0) on an empty pipe reports nothing ready
after a write the pipe read end polls POLLIN ready
select() agrees the read end is readable
closing the write end makes the read end poll ready (POLLHUP/POLLIN, EOF)

forbidden.why: poll falsely reported an empty pipe ready
select disagreed with the pipe state
poll missed POLLHUP/EOF on a closed write end
